invariants.name: acyclic_subgraph_single_root
invariants.description: During the traversal and modification process, every visited connected component becomes acyclic and, once the root is established, all visited vertices form a single rooted tree directed toward that root.

properties.acyclic_after_handling: After processing a component, no cycle of length > 1 remains among visited vertices.
properties.unique_root_once_set: When root != -1, exactly one self-loop (the root) exists in the visited subgraph, and every other visited vertex has a directed path leading to this root.
